channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Jae Crowder | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Jae Crowder from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Grayson Allen on Jae Crowder
item.description:
Bobby Manning:Allen on Jae Crowder:

“Jae's now been in every city I've been in in the NBA, so it's nice to see a familiar face. I know exactly what he can do. I think we all know exactly how he fits on the team. He's going to help us a lot, so we're just excited.”

Grayson Allen on Jae Crowder, Feb 14, 2023. Source: Twitter @RealBobManning.

item.title: Mat Ishbia on Jae Crowder
item.description:
Mat Ishbia:

“We obviously have one player (Jae Crowder) that we have to move. This team, from my personal perspective, we have a championship-caliber team right now with no changes. If I can take an upgrade from a player that is not playing to a player that is playing, we’ve gotten even closer and if I can do more than that, I’m sure that would be even better.”

Mat Ishbia on Jae Crowder, Feb 7, 2023. Source: Arizona Republic.

item.title: Landry Shamet on Jae Crowder
item.description:
Gerald Bourguet:Landry Shamet on the Jae Crowder situation:

“I feel like what we have here is really strong. I love Jae. I love him to death. Everyone's got their own path.”

Landry Shamet on Jae Crowder, Sep 26, 2022. Source: Twitter @GeraldBourguet.

item.title: Mikal Bridges on Jae Crowder
item.description:
Mikal Bridges on the Jae Crowder situation:

“It sucks. I love 99. I remember telling him all the time he's one of my favorite vets ever. It's one of those things, it's just how the business goes.”

Mikal Bridges on Jae Crowder, Sep 26, 2022. Source: Twitter @GeraldBourguet.

item.title: Deandre Ayton on E'Twaun Moore, Jae Crowder, Langston Galloway, Torrey Craig
item.description:
“In the bubble, with the way we handled ourselves, team success comes with individual accolades. I think that is what really happened in the bubble. I saw each and every one of us really grow. We won some games and we started to put the right staff in. That is why we are here, to be honest. Whatever we are doing [now], was built in the bubble. “Winning was contagious and we added pieces like CP, Jae [Crowder], E’Twaun Moore, Langston Galloway and Torrey Craig. Those are guys who have been in the game and played at high levels like this. That is the best way I can think of how I turned my career into a positive one.”

Deandre Ayton on E'Twaun Moore, Jae Crowder, Langston Galloway, Torrey Craig, Jun 23, 2021. Source: The Undefeated.

item.title: Julius Randle on Jae Crowder
item.description:
Stefan Bondy:Julius Randle on Jae Crowder:

“He’s just a frontrunner. He didn’t say a word in the first half. They were down and they tied the game up and he got a stop on me and wanted to say something. That’s just who he is. Everybody in the league knows it. But I’m not worried about him.”

Julius Randle on Jae Crowder, May 8, 2021. Source: Twitter @SBondyNYDN.

item.title: Monty Williams on Jae Crowder
item.description:
Gerald Bourguet:Monty on Jae Crowder:

“I don't really have anything to say about his situation. There's no new updates, we hope to get him back here soon.”

Monty Williams on Jae Crowder, May 5, 2021. Source: Twitter @GeraldBourguet.

item.title: Devin Booker on Jae Crowder
item.description:
Gerald Bourguet:Devin Booker on Jae Crowder and some of the other additions:

“We definitely have some dogs, man. We have some go-getters. We have some people that don't want their man to score.”

Devin Booker on Jae Crowder, Dec 3, 2020. Source: Twitter @GeraldBourguet.

item.title: Monty Williams on Jae Crowder
item.description:
Monty on Jae Crowder:

“I love his versatility, I love his toughness...we liked the fact that he proved his shooting last year.”

Monty Williams on Jae Crowder, Dec 1, 2020. Source: Twitter @GeraldBourguet.

item.title: Brad Stevens on Jae Crowder
item.description:
Stevens on Crowder:

“When Jae got traded here I thought this was going to be perfect, and it has been.”

Brad Stevens on Jae Crowder, Mar 28, 2018. Source: Twitter @AdamHimmelsbach.

item.title: Al Horford on Jae Crowder
item.description:
Horford on Jae Crowder, who makes his return to Boston tomorrow:

“He’s a hard worker, has a great heart and is a great competitor. He gave everything he had for the Celtics.”

Al Horford on Jae Crowder, Jan 2, 2018. Source: Twitter @celtics.

item.title: Dwyane Wade on Jae Crowder
item.description:
Dwyane Wade almost missed his cue when he was introduced as a Cavs starter for the first time.

“I heard ‘starting at forward, from Marquette’ so immediately I was like, Jae Crowder,”

Dwyane Wade on Jae Crowder, Oct 5, 2017. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Koby Altman on Jae Crowder
item.description:
#CavsKoby Altman:

“Jae Crowder is a guy we have liked for a long time. Contributes to winning at a high level”

Koby Altman on Jae Crowder, Sep 7, 2017. Source: Twitter @ChrisFedor.

item.title: Draymond Green on Jae Crowder
item.description:
Draymond Green:

“And then the Cavs getting IT and also getting a top-5 pick. I think the underrated part of that trade though is Jae Crowder, who’s on a team-friendly deal and is one of the best perimeter defenders our league has seen and can knock a shot down.”

Draymond Green on Jae Crowder, Aug 25, 2017. Source: SB Nation.

item.title: Jimmy Butler on Jae Crowder
item.description:
Chuck Garfien:Jimmy Butler on buddy Jae Crowder:

“He fouled me hard as sh-t (in Game 1) when I was going to the basket, so I got one for him tonight.”

Jimmy Butler on Jae Crowder, Apr 18, 2017. Source: Twitter @ChuckGarfien.

item.title: Brad Stevens on Jae Crowder
item.description:
Brian Robb:Brad Stevens on Crowder outburst:

“To be honest I was somewhat surprised to read what he said and tweeted. I told him that this morning.”

Brad Stevens on Jae Crowder, Jan 4, 2017. Source: Twitter @CelticsHub.

item.title: Brad Stevens on Jae Crowder
item.description:
Marc D'Amico:Stevens on Crowder's ankle:

“He's progressed well. He led us in minutes Fri night, played a number of different positions & did a good job.”

Brad Stevens on Jae Crowder, Dec 5, 2016. Source: Twitter @celtics.

item.title: Jimmy Butler on Jae Crowder
item.description:
Sean Highkin:Jimmy Butler on altercation with Crowder:

“Jae's my guy. In the heat of the moment, that's what's supposed to happen.”

Jimmy Butler on Jae Crowder, Oct 28, 2016. Source: Twitter @highkin.

item.title: Amir Johnson on Jae Crowder
item.description:
Marc D'Amico:Amir Johnson on Jae Crowder:

“It definitely won’t surprise me if he’ll be an All-Star because he’s a versatile player and a great scorer.”

Amir Johnson on Jae Crowder, Oct 24, 2016. Source: Twitter @celtics.

item.title: Brad Stevens on Jae Crowder
item.description:
Jay King:Stevens on Crowder's timetable from the initial injury:

“Minimum of two (weeks). But most likely that’s a very, very conservative estimate. He said he’s feeling better but there’s a big difference between that and playing a game.”

Brad Stevens on Jae Crowder, Mar 21, 2016. Source: Twitter @ByJayKing.

item.title: Evan Turner on Jae Crowder
item.description:
Evan Turner on Crowder's two-week timetable:

“I just heard about it. That's definitely tough. In general, Jae's playing so great.”

Evan Turner on Jae Crowder, Mar 13, 2016. Source: Twitter @ByJayKing.

item.title: Doc Rivers on Jae Crowder
item.description:
Gary Washburn:Doc on Jae Crowder:

“He's a great example of you can be tough and mean and a great guy at the same time. That's what you like about him.”

Doc Rivers on Jae Crowder, Feb 11, 2016. Source: Twitter @GwashburnGlobe.

item.title: Rick Carlisle on Jae Crowder
item.description:
Tim MacMahon:Rick Carlisle on Jae Crowder, who has blossomed in Boston after Dallas traded him in the Rajon Rondo deal:

“He's gotten better virtually every game. This is no surprise for us. We loved him here.”

Rick Carlisle on Jae Crowder, Jan 18, 2016. Source: ESPN.com.

item.title: Rick Carlisle on Jae Crowder
item.description:
Marc D'Amico:Rick Carlisle on Jae Crowder:

“Crowder's a terrific player, and we knew he was a rising star (when he was) with us.”

Rick Carlisle on Jae Crowder, Nov 18, 2015. Source: Twitter @celtics.

item.title: Austin Ainge on Jae Crowder
item.description:
Marc D'Amico:Austin Ainge said defensive SFs have great value:

“Jae Crowder did a great job for us in that role this year; we could use a few more like that.”

Austin Ainge on Jae Crowder, Jun 1, 2015. Source: Twitter @celtics.

item.title: Rich Gotham on Jae Crowder
item.description:
Adam Himmelsbach:Celtics pres Gotham on Crowder:

“Jae is definitely a priority... He added toughness, energy & confidence. I think he gave our guys a swagger”

Rich Gotham on Jae Crowder, May 21, 2015. Source: Twitter @AdamHimmelsbach.

item.title: Danny Ainge on Jae Crowder
item.description:
Ainge said when asked about his interest in the free agents,

“I would just say that we like all of them to some degree. Some of it's going to be dependent on numbers and roster spots and draft and trades and everything else. Soyou just can't emphatically say anything about anybody, other than I can emphatically say that we will definitely qualify Jae Crowder, which I think is pretty obvious. But other than that, the unrestricted free agents, it's uncertain. But we do like each one of them and would welcome any one of them back at the right price and in the right role.”

Danny Ainge on Jae Crowder, Apr 30, 2015. Source: Boston Globe.

item.title: Brad Stevens on LeBron James, Jae Crowder
item.description:
Stevens on Crowder vs. LeBron:

“There's been good tough basketball on both ends. You have to play with that edge. (Jae) wants to compete.”

Brad Stevens on LeBron James, Jae Crowder, Apr 26, 2015. Source: Twitter @celtics.

item.title: LeBron James on Jae Crowder
item.description:
Ben Rohrbach:LeBron on Crowder:

“He’s a guy who tries to play hard and put his body on me to help his team win. That’s all.”

LeBron James on Jae Crowder, Apr 26, 2015. Source: Twitter @brohrbach.

item.title: Danny Ainge on Jae Crowder
item.description:
Ben Rohrbach:Ainge on Crowder in @Toucherandrich interview:

“We really did like Jae Crowder, and we feel like he’s a big part of our team going forward.”

Danny Ainge on Jae Crowder, Apr 23, 2015. Source: Twitter @brohrbach.
